Combat drugs: After all units have been set up, you may pick a combat drug for the unit. Its effect last for the remaining battle.

Power through Pain: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, the army gains a "Power Through Pain" token, which is assigned a special rule from the list. Then distribute the token to any friendly unit with the "Power Through Pain" special rule. All models in a unit benefit from the bonus, but multiple markers with the same bonus don't stack. Effects:
- Aegis(4+)
- Berserk(5+)
- Furious Charge
- +1 Initiative
- +1 Leadership
- +1 Strength
Character models that join a unit pool their "Power through Pain" token together. Once they leave the unit, these tokens have to be split up evenly.
Visitors of the Black Library: The army has access to Harlequin units. Harlequins can not be the mandatory HQ selection.
Webway raid: For each started 1000 points of game size, one infantry unit (including attached character models) may be set up using the rules for Infiltrators for +1 point per wound.
